result:
US March AP and expense review is complete. Summary of what I found and did:

**Corrected (3 entries posted, all with support attached):**
1. **Duplicate AP bill — Stackline Cloud STA-98877, $31,148.20.** Same invoice (DOC-0160) entered twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241); only one payment cleared the bank. Posted reversal **JE-00307** and, since it exceeds the $10k posting limit, **requested controller approval** (pending).
2. **Miscoding — Northgate NDC-7719, $3,880.** Booked to Meals & Entertainment as a "team dinner"; the invoice is actually colocation (2 racks, power, cross-connects). Posted **JE-00308** reclassing to 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure.
3. **Unrecorded $65 bank service charge** (BT-US-0085) — posted **JE-00309** to 6900.

**Escalated rather than forced:**
- **EXC-001 — $6,750 "Legal retainer" (JE-00288)** with no support at all; bank shows only an anonymous wire. Also likely a prepaid, not an expense. Left untouched pending engagement letter/invoice.
- **EXC-002 — duplicate $149.90 Zoom charge on 3/8.** Both charges genuinely cleared the bank, so the ledger is right; referred to AP for a vendor credit rather than posting an entry.

**Net effect:** March pre-tax expense down $31,083.20; AP down to $100,180 (opening migrated balance plus the open Northgate bill). AP cutoff review marked complete — all March vendor bills are recorded and no unrecorded March-service invoices exist. I also flagged in the memo that the $96,300 migrated AP balance is unsupported and that no March Figtree prepaid amortization was posted, both for follow-up outside this review.
